subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add Control UI save-time budget visibility and enforcement for MEMORY.md/bootstrap files now, and should archive assistance be in scope or split out?
rationale: Current main already has prompt, /context, and doctor diagnostics, but refusing saves and auto-archiving workspace memory are user-facing workflow and ownership decisions that source inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Add bounded UI enforcement
options.body: Implement the budget meter plus warning/blocking for bootstrap files and leave archive automation as a separate follow-up.

options.title: Keep diagnostics-only boundary
options.body: Treat prompt, /context, and doctor visibility as sufficient for now and close or narrow the UI/archive request separately.

options.title: Sponsor broader archive workflow
options.body: Design a memory lifecycle flow that can move old MEMORY.md sections safely before implementing save blocking.

recommendation.title: Add bounded UI enforcement
recommendation.body: Implement the budget meter plus warning/blocking for bootstrap files and leave archive automation as a separate follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras authored the central bootstrap warning and Agents dashboard history, so they are the best available owner for the product-scope choice.
